source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Topic 5.3.1.1 (PDF 134-135, printed 131-132).

blocks.text: Kabhi data adhoora hota hai ya us mein missing values (ghayab qeematein) hoti hain. Inhein handle karne (sambhalne) ke alag alag tareeqe hain. Agar missing values wali rows (lines) bohat kam hon to unhein hata sakte hain. Doosra tareeqa yeh hai ke ghayab qeemat average se ya milte julte cases ke data se bhar di jaye. Kaunsa tareeqa chunna hai, yeh data ki qism aur is baat par depend karta hai ke kitna data ghayab hai.
Misal: Students ke grades ke dataset mein agar Sara ka grade ghayab ho to us ki performance (kitna achha kiya) ka andaza lagana mushkil hai. Is ke liye yeh tareeqe istemal ho sakte hain:

items: Imputation (andaze se bharna): jo data paas hai us se ghayab qeemat ka andaza lagaya jata hai. Misal: school Sara ki class ke sab students ka average grade nikalta hai. Agar average 82 ho to filhal yahi qeemat Sara ke record mein likh di jaye. Is tarah dataset poora (complete) rehta hai aur Sara ki performance ke bare mein ek reasonable (theek lagne wala) andaza lagta hai.

Flagging (nishan lagana): school dataset mein note laga deta hai ke Sara ka grade available (maujood) nahi. Is se analysts ko pata rehta hai ke data adhoora hai. Yeh tareeqa transparent (sab ke saamne saaf) hai aur khali jagah bhare baghair analysis chalta rehta hai.

Removal (nikal dena): agar ghayab entries kam hon to school kuch khaas analyses se Sara ka record nikal sakta hai. Yeh tab theek hai jab is se students ki overall performance (sab ki mili juli karkardagi) ki samajh par zyada asar na pade. Lekin is se Sara ke bare mein qeemti information zaya (khatam) ho sakti hai.

blocks.text: Yeh program ghayab grade (None) ko baqi students ke average se bharta hai (imputation) aur saath note bhi lagata hai (flagging). grades mein koi aur qeemat None kar ke ya numbers badal kar Run karein.

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"names" aur "grades": paanch students aur un ke grades; None ka matlab hai grade ghayab (missing) hai.
"known = [g for g in grades if g is not None]": sirf woh grades jo maujood hain: [80, 85, 78, 85].
"average = sum(known) / len(known)": 328 / 4 = 82.0; yahi ghayab grade ki jagah bhara jayega (imputation).
"for name, grade in zip(names, grades):": zip() dono lists ko jor kar har student ka naam aur grade saath saath deta hai.
"if grade is None:": grade ghayab ho to average (round se 1 decimal) print hota hai aur saath note "<- missing, filled with class average" (flagging, yani nishan lagana).
"else:": grade maujood ho to wohi grade print hota hai.
Output: "Ali : 80", "Hina : 85", "Sara : 82.0  <- missing, filled with class average", "Bilal : 78", "Zara : 85". print() har hisse ke beech space lagata hai, is liye naam aur ":" ke beech space aata hai.
Khud try karein: Hina ka 85 bhi None kar dein: ab average [80, 78, 85] se 81.0 banega aur Hina aur Sara dono ko 81.0 milega.

blocks.prompt: Sara ke liye class ka average 82 bharna misleading (ghalat raah dikhane wala) kyun ho sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Sara ka asal grade class average se kahin zyada ya kam ho sakta hai. Is liye bhari hui qeemat ko andaza likh kar nishan lagana (flag) chahiye aur asal grade milne par badal dena chahiye.

items: Missing data: imputation (maslan class ka average), flagging ya removal; har ek ke faide aur nuqsan.
